    Lagged and cumulative propagule pressure features

    Source: R/recipes-steps.R
    step_inv_propagule_lags.Rd

    step_inv_propagule_lags() creates a specification of a recipe step that adds, for each selected propagule pressure column, its values lag time steps earlier within each group, the cumulative pressure before the current time step and, optionally, an exponentially discounted cumulative pressure sum(x_s * exp(-decay * (t - s))) over earlier times s. These features capture the delayed effect of past introductions on establishment and spread. Rows keep their original order.

    Usage

    step_inv_propagule_lags(
  recipe,
  ...,
  role = "predictor",
  trained = FALSE,
  time,
  group = NULL,
  lag = 1,
  cumulative = TRUE,
  decay = NULL,
  prefix = "lag",
  columns = NULL,
  skip = FALSE,
  id = recipes::rand_id("inv_propagule_lags")
)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_propagule_lags'
prep(x, training, info = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_propagule_lags'
bake(object, new_data, ...)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_propagule_lags'
print(x, width = max(20, options()$width - 30), ...)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_propagule_lags'
tidy(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_propagule_lags'
required_pkgs(x, ...)

    Arguments

    recipe

    A recipe object.

    ...

    One or more selector functions choosing numeric propagule pressure columns.

    role

    Role of the new columns. Defaults to "predictor".

    trained

    A logical to indicate if the step has been trained.

    time

    Name of the time column (bare or quoted).

    group

    Optional name of a grouping column (for example region).

    lag

    Positive whole numbers: lags (in rows within group, ordered by time) to create.

    cumulative

    Add the cumulative pressure before each time step?

    decay

    Optional non-negative decay rate per time unit.

    prefix

    Prefix for lag column names.

    columns

    Set by prep(): the selected column names.

    skip

    A logical. Should the step be skipped when the recipe is baked by bake()? Defaults to TRUE because the step removes rows.

    id

    A character string that is unique to this step.

    x

    A step_inv_propagule_lags object.

    training

    A data frame used to train the step.

    info

    Variable information from the recipe.

    object

    A trained step.

    new_data

    A data frame to process.

    width

    Print width.

    Value

    An updated recipe. New columns are named {prefix}{lag}_{column}, cumpp_{column} and decaypp_{column}; the first rows of each group have NA lags. tidy() returns terms, lag and id.

    Examples

    library(recipes)
annual <- inv_introductions |>
  dplyr::count(region, year, wt = propagule_size, name = "propagules")
rec <- recipe(~., data = annual) |>
  step_inv_propagule_lags(propagules, time = year, group = region, lag = 1:2,
    decay = 0.2)
bake(prep(rec), new_data = NULL)
